tags.TITLE: It's Hard To Care
tags.LYRICS:
It’s hard to care

Made of an alloy, impervious to hoopla
Sinks in the water, but stays for a coopla
Amass a collection, stow it somewhere
A knack for the picks
U-Store-It’s right there
Right there

Well, it’s hard to care
Master a skill, abandon a hobby
Prawning with Mikey, no golfing with Robby
Beeline to trouble to manage the tussles
Vexed by your capers, saved by your muscles

It’s hard to care

A yeoman, a monkey, factotum, or drudge
Shoulder a burden, carry a grudge
Unstinting and candid, clever and strapping
Look up at the ceiling
How is this happening?

It’s hard to care

There’s time on your hands, there’s dew on your cheeks
Without you the whole thing collapses in weeks
Rise to the challenge, get up and give’er
Laugh at your fortune
And cry me a river

It’s hard to care
